text: Waʼan teni ku intranta paʼitun ku shaʼwikunawe, ku nun yaʼweriun iyaruʼsa ku nanitaunawe kakankaru aʼna Yunsaʼpa. ku nuyawantuachinawe, ku nanichitrawe pentunkaru ihpera. Paʼa ninataʼawa, manuwiramawe con ihkantamawe ninanu ku uʼnayantasu.
ku Ihpera tashi tewarawe.
Ninuwinu nuya akankanteke, kantake aʼna kantu.

Iʼsha pamatuachina, weʼpisu niʼtauna ku nanitaunawe kankakaru ninanuke ku tahshiwiriunwe. Waʼan tenin ku keʼken peʼpeterinsu ku aʼnaruachin kanʼitun, Nahpuatun peʼpetun patuchitunawe iʼsha yunsanke aʼnaruahchin pakakamare aʼnateran, Kuʼwana tahshitarin yaʼiwi.
¿Paʼanke ku nihpun kanpiateke shiʼshinen?
Ama naʼnekes, weke ihse karuʼku.
Iratuwatun ikiruaran nimara naʼkun.
Uʼmaiteriwau ku tahshiyahtarasu, mama ku nanichitun weʼekasu pen pirian ninaraʼitunpuau
Ama manukesu, chinuhteke.
Ku ahkete nuya kanterau ihsu uʼnanin niʼtun.

Paʼanaʼpi sanapi ku nuwanteriunwe pantaʼpi kanuwi inawintanken Ku interante nuwanteriunwe niʼtun. Nanun sanapi yunkirin mamapayanen kashin kemayachinin ninanuakeran. Ihperasu Kuwai yaʼweriunwe kashin waʼwaruʼsamare nahpuatun ninuwikeʼpa ikihterin.
Ama uʼnai ateʼwainkesu, waʼwa. Pen iʼchinpirawatun ninateke; tahshira pihpikaunwe piʼi inauchin winakaunwe.

Waʼwasha, ku kahsu nuyau kankanchitu mamanen kanuhtuwinan kankimawachin ahkeran. Nihpiriunwe ku nahkawitu sehtupina. ku winawirinsu, ku nihtuchitu unpuinta paʼninke. kari ninaitu yaʼkuanapirian, nihpiriunwe ku weʼeitu nihkatu. ku tashi nuwantrawe iratakasu. ku ina shaʼwiriun nahpurini, ka kanka ku nuya yaʼwechitunku.
Ama piʼpihshamare paʼankesu, ahpiawa, manurawiraunta; ihsu nanpiru sami naʼkun paʼterin, ku nanitereu tuhpinan yuhkakasu iʼke manesu.
nani ahke paʼnaike,uʼmarai kuʼana iʼwayahtasewe.kema pichiran nunsharuʼsa iʼsha yunsake.kahsu ira aʼnurawe

¿Ku nihka nahtantarewau yaʼinpua wiʼshakaru nunpisu nimiriu kehkamare inaran aʼchintarinpu unpu kuidakasu kañaʼpiruʼsa yun kañuwisu ninanuke? Mahshuruʼsa, aʼtantupiʼ iʼsha tahpawisu, nihpiriunwe nahtanterai nuya ina nihpachin ama kañukamaru wai.
Shantamari peʼike, ¿Ku yunkirewa nihka, aʼma yaʼihpi tihkiaʼwaru, tahpaʼawa puʼpianmiachin Kurihke? Naʼkun yunkirewa pamatuachin ku sami yaʼwapun. ¿Nahpuatun yunkirewa tahpakasuʼ kurihke?
Iʼwata kai. Kema nimara umpuwachina pahkariu niʼnanku uʼnanpachina, nuyahsha nuntuwatankura keshirinku piʼpian penenpuchin
Ku Kiʼsha nuya peʼtenariwau kenewa nahpuni kuʼwaranta weʼshatarasu, ku nituhchiteriwau unpusuna kurihki maʼpatakasu kanpuasu tewechiteriwau mirkatuke.
Ama nahtantesu pawere ihpua, mama; ku nanitariwau paweretakasu ku shiʼshi yanihpachiun; ku nihpunau ahkete aninatarainkeun.
iʼwaraya kankiwachina,tahkuiterai peen tana paʼtakasumare.inara uʼmarai nahpuinahchin peike,inauchin ninae mama nanpirinpuchin
¿Nuntaunken nunentuʼpi sanapi tahshiria?
Ka kurihki puʼpian tahparauwe kusharumare inaran puʼpian puʼpian ketrauwe shiaʼwanupita uʼmawatraunwe.
Ama pataʼawa inaura imuya nuyamashu inasu.
Kenan tanpanante ninanukeran, nuya.
Ama sehtekesu uʼnanpachin. Weke, kaʼtanpu kayurun sanapi kuidaʼa nanianteke sehteransu.
Ku taʼtaʼiteriwau ahke paʼnewa nahpuni: tata shaʼwichiteriwau ama ninainpuasumarewe.
Ku kaurahchin ya naʼnerawe aʼshatu. Weke peiʼpa karin ihpuʼinke; ku niʼpaterankun ku naniterawe winaʼkuaru
Ku muhturu tenentuwachiun, ku nanitariwau pakakasu, nahpurawatun ku inkantariwau ninanu pihtanen.
Iʼchinpirarawe nanparin nuyahsha kankantawatu.
¿Nuya niʼitun chinkana waʼanen yunkirin nahpuni tatamahshuin irahka niwike tumaʼ yuʼninsu, inaran pawere nahtanterin nuyahshskeran ku nuʼwitaunau?
¿Ku kemasu nuya kankantraunwe kayaʼya ku wai sapuriunwe niʼtun? Shaʼwituku, ¿Ihperawanta kemahsu sehtaran?
¿Ninin wiʼshakaun kirihkake nunentun peike?

Ina ku kankiriunwe seʼkatun tanpanante arce, paʼ anaʼpi kemawi Ku naʼkun paweririunwe niʼtun. Irahka aʼshin paʼanpiriunwe sami nanpiru nahpuatun nuya kankantawatun uʼmarin. Ihperasu Kuwai inauchin, nahpuatun nanun sanapi Ku kenaniunwe nuya kankantakaru irahka yaʼwerinsu waʼwishitaunwe.
Uʼmaitu nimara kanuhpenaʼpi irake.
Nahpunin ninahtanau ku kaʼtanpachinarau.
¿Sami kechinken itauntu ketinkemare?
¿unpanta kahpa kankanterin yunkiwachina shiaʼwain paʼninsu istutiaun?...

Amiaʼwa, kahsu ku nuyau nuyau niʼitu kema ku niʼkin tawatanku ihsu piʼihpike. Ku winainen yaʼwewachinwe ka peinuku, kahsu ku yunkiʼitu nuya taweriruʼsa. Tahpaʼitu nuya taweriruʼsa waʼwasha imiraraʼwaruʼsa. Kari ninaʼitun iʼsha yunsanke, nihpiriunwe ku nuʼwichitu wenuka yaʼwerin nahpurin. Ku nuʼwichitu taweri naʼweʼkuaru kaurahchin. Ku kema uʼmawataun, ka nanpirausu ku yaʼwechihtun paʼya kankan waʼwi.

¿Ku kemasu nuya kankanchintun tatanen uʼmarin nuya peʼirinkeran? Ninarama yaʼi iʼwaraya wensatuwi iʼsha yunsanke. Tehpi kenin nuhtuaru panka sami. ¿Ku nihka naʼwanaunwe ihsu tawerirusa ahke paʼnin niʼtun? Ka tenawe taʼararan niʼpatan ihpukamare kankirasu. Nuya nanan nihkaunwe yaʼiwimare peʼike. ¿Tewenchi ihpera tahshi kushatarewa yaʼinpua inaran yaʼiwi shaʼwitaun ninansu ku ina nihsasu?
Kema paʼpatan, ka nihpiriunwe unkuchitu aʼnatauri sahkatrausu. Ama napukesu iya. karin naʼkun naʼwaintenkeun.- karin ta, nahpuanauwe aʼnataweri ni kenantari pantaʼpi niʼantari nahkeranchi, iyamashu.
¿Inta pintihserin peʼpetu kuʼwara pihpiatarasu? Mahshu samikamayu, kahpashin kankantatun nunin, yusparin iterin iʼsha inaran achiʼyaterin kusharu pakasumare nuyahkeran.
Muhshake aʼshinparin, taʼteke.
Inahsu ku shaʼwiriun niyakapawisu kahpa kankantupisu; tenin nuya nanan weʼsarinsu ku nuʼteun nihsapirinwe, ku nuwanteriun yusparin tehkakasu kuʼwara kankiyahtarasu.

Waʼwa, ku kasu winaʼitu ku tata sami kemariunwe nahpurin. ku nuʼwitumantaitu. ku winarinwe nahpurini ku nihtuchituwe iʼke nuya paʼninsu. kari weʼehta yaʼwetawatu ninaʼitu, nihpirinwe ku nuʼwichituwe ninaterawasu. Ku nuwanchituwe amanukaru. ku ina aʼnarahchin kankiwachinwe, ku nanichintuwe kusharu kusinakaru yaʼihpimare.

¿Waʼwasha weʼka ichihtunwe mamapayanen iminkeran uʼmararin niʼnin nihpuni? Ina ikirurin ahke ira paʼtatun, ¿Ku peʼpetu kepachihtunwe? Aʼshimuhtunen, manureʼna, yunkirin: ku nuyawe ina nahtantakahsu unpuinta paʼnin? Tatamahshu ushahkeran nuwararin nunshinankeʼ pa, ¿Ku kaʼtanawe nuyahshakeran? Aʼna nuya waʼwasha inaʼtun weʼka iterin piyapiruʼsa tanankeran uʼmawisu.
¿Ku nuyau ihpura nikatun kemapi, yamura niwike ketakasu aʼna mahshu, paʼpinsu irahka ku awaʼkiriun paweretaun niwiterinsu?

¿Ku nimara interanta ninaʼitun? waʼkiraran yaʼnatimarin pentunshinanke, ku nanitaun naʼkutamasu aʼnawita pentushinan kuʼwaranta tahshiatarasu. Ninanusu ahke, shiaʼwa. ku kahsu iʼwaria pakamasu nuwantupirawe. Pakeway, ama ahkete waʼkikesu.

Nahtantenke aʼnaruachin nani unkutapi. Aʼna sanapi nuwantuachin sami paʼantakamare, kema shaʼwiteke unputa paʼterin. Ama puʼpian aʼpatekesu manuwatan. Sami nanpiru naʼkun paʼterin, kemasu kenan iʼkera tahshiramiachin. Nuya Paʼanke, ama ni kanatekesu.
¿Maʼpataun tuhpinan aʼyaitresu samimanaʼpi kemawi inaran paweretaun, u nunihkaun aʼna ku naʼkun paʼtrinsu aʼna sanawiʼpa nunshinan pirin waʼwerinsu?
Chinuhtaun, wankana irake ahke irataran.
¿Ku nuya Kankanteranwe, amiaʼwa, iyamashu tanankeran nuya kankimarin niʼtun? Sehtu nanianteke nuyahsa kankanteke yuhse yunkiatun.
Nahpunin kankanterau ku paʼyatuachinkurau.
¿Uʼmakaun iyawe iminkeran? Nahtanawe aʼshatunu aʼnarahchin, nihpunawe ku ina aʼpanirinku, naʼkun sehterawe yaʼipi iʼwaria.

ku sehteitu yuʼyu uʼmarin nahpurin tanankeran, waʼkirin nahpurini ku nuwichitu. kari ku tahpaitu paya yaʼpirane. ku niʼnawe irake iraterinsu, kari ku nahteitu uʼmarinsu. Ninaitu iminke, nahpuatun ku ina yunkiatu chinuhchituwe. ku nuantrawe ayataʼkuasu nahkeranchin. ku ina kankiwachinwe, waʼyanu nahpunin kankanchitun.
Kahtaʼawa imuya kuidarinpusu inaura.
Mamapaya ku nuwanterawe kawera peike kehparitaʼwakauhsu, Weke niʼkiku, ketuku winaransu, ku ina ketewatanku sehtarawe, ku yaʼnipiarawe.
Aʼnatauri iyahsa paʼpachina sahkataun ahke, ina ninahtanin inarauhchin iminke. ku ina sehtekaru nihpiriunwe, iyashanen uʼmarin tihkiwachin senahterinkeran.
Niamiriake, chinihken kankanteke.
Ama uhshipari anaʼnekesu.

Ku waʼan tehpachiunwe, piyawihsa kankiwisu ku kanʼitunauwe ninanuke ku keʼparichitunawe ina tahshi. Ku iʼsha paʼmaiwachiunwe, ku nanituchimawe kankakaru peʼpetune aʼnateran yunsaʼpa. Waʼan itarima ku naʼkun peʼpetakaru, manuwatama naʼkun peʼpetawatama ku intranta nuya kankaun.
Uhsaran uʼmaʼitu, peʼperawatu,
Yahkeparan kusharu shaaruʼsa mirkatuke, wiʼnau, paʼanan kuʼwaranta wenukari awimechahtarasu.
Aʼnaiken ihsu saminanpiruʼ kemanta kiʼsha ketuku.
Ku ihsu yuhki shapun sewararewau
Perahku kemaura uʼnanke nihsawatan. Wekapu mamaruʼku shaʼwitaunken unpuwisuna irahka tewakaun yaʼipi iʼwaria.
Kepake iʼsha kanuhtuatan.
Uʼnan pei aipi anuntuachin, kahtuenpu niihpuaʼa, shiʼawa
Nani tuminku keparan mahkira ninanuke, nihpunau ku paʼtuachinau sehterimaran.
naʼwamaranken peinen ahke nininsu
Ninaku ku paʼshaterasu.
Ka yuʼnawe atarikayu arce maʼpatakamare, nahpuatun tenawe nuya ina nihkakaru anauchin yaʼiwi ninanu kahtaware.

¿Ku kemasu nuya Kankankaunwe nituhtuatan ina aʼchinaʼpi wantawachi aʼchinpeike? kema Mamanen shaʼwitrinku nuya nanan karihsu nahterawe. Waʼwaruʼsasu ninatauna naʼkeranchin aʼchin peike yaʼkunkaru, irahkauchin. ¿Ku nihka naʼwanaunwe aʼchinpeike yaʼkunkaru iyaruʼsawita? Niʼkena yaʼiwi inauchin nihkaunwe. Kari Kaʼtaʼinke aʼna taweriraʼ, amiaʼwa. ¿Tewenchin kemanta nuya kankantaunwe nituhtakaru nahkeranchin inaran yaʼnuikaru iʼiʼratekeʼ aʼnawitare?
¿Unputa paweretaun nunenanke niʼtun, u aʼnanuna pantaʼpi ketaunku kayawachin?
waʼwin naʼkun ihpera naʼwanin
¿Ku ina waʼwasha nuteriuni mamapayanen kenanatun nunshinan irake?
Tahpuna kahtawaranken sami paʼanan.
Weʼkama aʼshatu. kemanta kemaurachin ninahtanan uʼnanpachina, umpuwachina naʼkun yunkiteran waʼwanpita ahke paʼpisu ihsu sehtu tawerike

text: ¿Ku kemasu nuya kankantraunwe kumuna sahkatu nuya taʼwantrin niʼtun? Shaʼwituku ¿unpuanta yaʼpiranen sehtereuchi niʼteran, shiaʼwanu?
Ku nuwanterawe pei nanpinan kehparitaʼwakauhsu, tatamashu. Yuhsemare weke iʼshanakeran, wenseke karuʼku, ka nuya kankanterawe niʼpatananken.
¿Naʼwanan kema taweriruʼsa kemupiruʼsa nahpuinachin yaʼwewisu? Yunkike nuya yaʼweresu, kusharu ninausu paʼyateramasu,
Nahpuinachin paʼaan inaran maʼa kurihki,waʼwaruʼsa aʼchinpeike maʼsha pawantapimare.
Kema yahkenan pantaʼpiruʼsa nunke, nihpunau ku ahkete paʼteriun ku inkantarinpu arehse paʼanamare.
Ku ihpura pawerearankeun, iyaraʼwa nani senatuwatu ketaranken pawanarinsu, ku naniantaraiwe.
¿Nuya chinuhteke aʼnarahchin nuyahtamare?
naʼkun panka iraterawe inaran naʼnerausu kaʼtaninku yaʼipi taweri

suʼpinke nihkaunpuchin iʼwarinsu iʼsha sanuirinken inaran tahshirinke

Waʼan tenin ku nancha nuwituatamawe iyaruhsa ku nanitaunawe kankakaru ninanuke peʼnate. ku kuʼsakai taʼtewachiunwe, ku nuya niʼitun pihpikasu iʼsha yunsankera. Maniatun nanuku peʼpetunusa kehku, ku shaʼwiwachinawe ku intranta pakaunwe ku iʼwatasu.
nunsha?ninuwinen ninarin ayanakasuʼ,irahka yaʼwerinsuʼ iyunsanke
Uʼnanpachin, kehpariteke kemaura peike ku nihka yunkiteranwe nuya nuntakaru ina piyapiruʼsa ku kemare iraterinsu.
Ku naʼkun aʼpaterawe amunuʼsa aʼnarahchin paʼankamare niʼtun, inaran kurihki shiaʼwapita yuʼnawe kaʼtaninawe niʼtun.
Nuantrawe nahpuriri, imaʼitenkeun nunkeʼpa. Ama yunkikesu, iyaya. ka sehtawe patuatanku. Karin Yusparinken itranke ya paʼasaran niʼtun, iyasha. Kahtawaranku kiʼsha sahku peʼpetranku wankuru.
¿yunkiran paʼsarai iterainsu? Paʼnai nunke ahke nuʼserateke maiteratui, kunimara inkanteraiun ihpukainsu nahpuru aʼkayan.
Ku kiyahsu paʼsaraiu ku shaʼwitaunkenaiuʼ, nunsuʼ paʼpi yaʼkumin ku ahkete naʼkun peʼpetu kepariwe peʼnate.
Ku nuyahsa kankanteriunwe sehteru taweri.
Kenankaun ira, paʼpi ikirutupirinwe

Ku uʼnan naʼweriunwe nahpurini, piyapiʼsa iratuisu ku kankuʼintunau ku taʼshiyahtrasu ninanuke. Waʼan teʼitun ku intranta kehparitaun inaura, ku nikaʼtanpumau tanansu ku intranta aʼpurariun. Pachina panka peʼpetun ahnaruachin iratakamare munshinan pakatun.
Nahtanan tananwapuchin uʼnan peiwite irintuwachina, yunkiran ihpuinensu nuya kankantamare.
Uʼnanpachina ku interanta niʼnau.
Manuku, ku manuwatewau nunke ku taweriachin inkanariwau kashinenpua paʼanakasu, yaʼipi pakauna mirkatuke.
¿Unpuanta ina yaʼpira sehterin? Tahshira papanu peʼirarin tuʼwana kemanta ketaunke aʼnara. Ninataʼawa nunen waʼiwinpua, ¿nuwanteran?
Mentahteran arehse tanpananteke.
Nani taweri keparan kiʼsha ninanuke, kuʼwaranta ahkete nahpunin nihshahtarasu yaʼipi paʼanan.
¿Kehteran kurihki ahpintaʼ?
Ku nuwanterawe kaura ihseke nihsarausu.
Keparawe yaʼnupi. ku kaura iratarawe.

¿Ninatanwe karuʼku wepiʼsu ahkeran ninanukeran, amiaʼwa? Kesawi nahsha nararia iminmare. ¿Ku nihka nuya kankantanwe shaʼpatan imirankeran? Tehpi kankauna ku taʼshiasu. ¿Ku nihka naʼwananwe maʼsha shahkamare nuʼpake? Karin aʼchinchin inseketa iwatakamare. Nuya nanan nihkaunwe yaʼimare sahkatuisu nuʼpake. ¿Tewenchin kemasu cuidararan sharuʼsa nihtakaware kapakamare?
Ama teʼwaʼasu, paʼawa nuntaʼa imuyanta.

Ina ku naniteriunwe ayankasu asuhkaru inaran nuʼmuhkeneʼ, nimara ku inshaterantari pantaʼpinen nuwantupiuwe ihpura. Nanunsha mama yunkirin sehtukeran ninanukeʼpa mentapi piyapiruʼsa yaʼi paʼantakaimare. Ihpurasu ku yaʼwepiuwe paʼantupihsu nimantaratun ayankasu iratupinan ahke nahtanin.
¿Ikihtaran ihperanta ninuwi? Paʼsare nihkari sami ni irarinsu kema winararan. Ama naʼnekesu, iyaraʼwa.
¿Ahpira Ahpira nihka peʼperai taʼna kehkeninsu?

Nanun sanapi Ku paʼaniunwe yamura ku suʼin paʼaniunwe sami ninanuke niʼtun. Yunkiki tehkei ketuachinpuara inapita Ku parsitiu inuachin. Ihperasuwai Ku kurihki naniriunwai nahpuatun ina Ku maʼshateranta keniun waʼwinpitamarewai.

ka amiaʼwanu, kari ku nuʼwiitun kema kankimawatan ninanukeran. ku paʼyanʼitu kema kañaʼpi uʼmawatan. ku winainen niʼpatu kasu yunkiitu ku nuyawe nihsaran. karin ninaitunke kusinapirianke, nihpiriunke ku sehtusu taʼteitun. ku yaniʼnanke naʼneransu. ku kema yaʼihpi shaʼwituwatanku, unpu nituhchita sehtaransu waʼwa.

Napupi ina sanapi paʼpi ya naʼnerin aʼnawita ya patuachina ninanunen. Nahpaware Ina nituhchitun paʼachina nanpinenpuke. Payu sehteri kaʼtanin iʼwaraya. ku nuyawe niunkurawikasumare. Nuya niʼitun shaʼwirin nahpurini sehterinsu kemuininpita.

NUya sami paʼanan nahpurini, kema ku kurihki teʼyachintun aʼnaruahchinmare. Tahpaʼintun tanaruʼsa tawerimare. Inake paʼaintun shapun kanchura tahshimare. Nituteke ihsu, waʼwa, kurihkisu ahnaruahchin taʼwanterin ku tahpawateru.
ku yuʼyu mare yamura yaʼweriun

Kema paʼanpatan sami nanpiru tahshiramiachin inaran puʼpian tahpawatan natakeʼ puʼuwatan. Inauchin,aʼnawita kañuwachinara, paweretakaru nimiriunen. Ina niʼitun tatanen ihse nihsarin nahpurini. Nituhteke tahpakaru, waʼwa, ku waʼiwi tihkikaru yaʼweriun ihpera.
Ama patukusuwe kaura ihpura, ahpi; ku kema kahtawawatunku ku naniterawe yamurataʼwasu ihsu samiruʼsa kuʼwaranta iʼwayatarasu.
¿Naniterin ina kemapi kepakasu niwii asukaru inaran paweretaksu pihkeran, irahkaruʼsapuchin ninahterewaʼ aʼna aʼnahken?
¿Tahparan maʼshateranta kiyamareʼ, mamapaya
Aʼnakaunkutu aʼyaitenanen, ihpura sami nanpirutarin.
Manuku, ku nuhsha ihpura peʼtenpatuwau ku nuyasha paʼankariwau, kanpuasu ku niwike nanitariwau ketakasu ninanuke yaʼwepisu.
ku iraterawe kaurahchin tahshiruʼpu.
¿Kepaun tuhpinan yamura shapune, paweretaun senatuatan kiʼsha iminenke aʼna yuhkiʼpa?
¿Pakaun aʼnarahchin nunentu sanapitaʼpa?
Iyarusaʼ ¿Ku nihka tenewaʼu sami pihshate paʼanpatuwa pahtuma kurihke tahpaʼawa? Naʼkun yunkirewa yamura paʼterin niʼtun. ¿Ku nihka inuachin yunkiramau wiʼnanpua waʼwashataun wensechinachin napuruwa
Amihke naʼneinen, yuhse nahteke.
¿Ni aʼpaikena iʼsha neʼwei nihsawasu?
¿Nanianteka samikamayu puʼmukasu aʼnahken kusharuʼ? Ku, yaʼipi nuya aʼpaiatun pichirin, nuya kankanterin, nani pakakasurahchin, tenin.
Nuya kankeran Yusparin itaʼwa yaʼyuranesu.
Ina ku winariunwe kahpa kemui nihpachina.
Inawasu ku kahpa kankantupirinau nuya nanan nininsu mirkatumare; tehpi ku nun yaʼwewachiun ku nanitupiwe kepakaisu maʼninteranta ku ahketeawaru nuyau niʼpi.
nuwa yuhke sami kechinen

Waʼ washa kenanin aʼna nunentenaʼpimahshu irake, ¿Ku nuyahsha weʼka iteriunwe? Aʼshimuhtunen, manurarin sahkatamare, nahtanin: ¿ku nuyawe Waʼwasha nunenan pahkaturu nahtantakahsu? Nunentenaʼpimahshu iʼsha ya pentuntarin nihpuni, ¿ku iʼwata ichihtuwe? Aʼ na nuya waʼwasha weʼka iterin mahshuruʼsa. ¿Ku nituchihtunwe nuya piyapitakahsu ahke tanan irake?
Yaʼkuana nuya unkutawe ihpera tahshi.

¿Nunchitun ina waʼwasha peʼinapi pentunpanchina ahketran? kemawi kanuhtatun kanpachina iʼkepa, ¿ina waʼwasha ku iʼsha puʼpian kechitun? Aʼshin mutu, manurarin wamukaimare, nahtananin: ¿ku waʼwasha nimara iʼwata nuyasha temarau? ¿Ku nimarau peʼinapi chinuhtaun puʼpian? Ina waʼwasha ahkeran weʼninu paʼpi nuyahpiachin nunterin irake kenaninsu.
yunkirau kahpa kankanteranke,iʼkuiteran yaʼi sehteruʼ
Ama taʼteanantesu, wiʼnau, chinihken shaʼwike paʼanchinen sami; ku nunpataun, ku interanta wekaun, ku nanitereu yuhkakasu uskurumare inaran yamuramareʼ
Tahparewa nihka kurihki maʼsha paʼanewasu.
Nuʼkirawe paʼanakaru iʼmeruʼsa piʼpiamiachin aʼpatarawe wankuruke, ina kanarawe paʼanawe yamura inaran uspuru yaʼiwimare kemuinupita.
Ama manuawasu, aʼshatu; ku pawerearankeun kuʼwaranta senachahtarasu, ku maʼsha kechinken itarankeun.
Aʼshin keparamara pantaʼpiruʼsa mirkatuke paʼanamare ihpura.
¿Naʼnahpun? Tata kepararinpu nunke tahshira inake niʼkarewa arahzu. Ka tenawe nuyahsha kankantaunwe.
Kahsu Sami paʼanpatuara wankuanake, waʼwapitaruʼku ni ketrai kurihki, inauchin achintrinai irahka.

Mahshuruʼsa wensechinachin, yunkirewa tahpakasu kurihki yaʼi paʼanewaʼsu ku manta yaʼwerinsu taweriruʼsa paʼantakasumare? Naʼnechinachin kankanterewa ku sami yaʼwepachinarawe. ¿Ku nihka yaʼinpua inuachin yunkirewawe kankanenpuaran.
Ku naniterawe akahpakankanausu mamapayanu nahpuru tahshi. Yakushateran itupirawe, inahsu ku aʼpanirinku tuhpinan naʼnarin.

Waʼwasha irake ni nahkawirin aʼna nunsha kepanaʼpire nihpuni, ¿ku nuyahshakeran weʼka ichihtunwe? Aʼshimuhtunen, manurarin shaʼwikamare sahkatu nihkamare ninanuke, nahtanin: ku nuyawe Waʼwasha nahtantakahsu piyapiruʼsa pentunpihsu ihpura? Nunsha kepanaʼpi nunsha nuyahtarin nunshinankeʼpa, ¿Ku kahtawaʼihtuwe puʼpian teranta? Aʼna waʼwasha nuya yinkinawan inaʼtun weʼka tenin. ¿Ku nituchihtunwe yaʼi nuhsurukamare?

Aʼnaruahchin, mahke nantupi. Atarikayu paʼanpatanan, kemasu inaʼtun nuya pichiteran. Ama ku naʼkun paʼantekesu paʼanapi kemapi amanuwachinken. Niʼke atariruʼsa kushatupi kemari yaʼitaweri niʼnansu. Nuya paʼanke ama nunpichinenwe.
Ama naʼneawasu irahka ni awerewamare; yaʼipi weʼkama itawa kuʼwaranta iʼke paʼshahtarusu.
Yunkirau kamamaresu ira ahketaran.
Ina ku ayateriun kunpurunta maʼsha yunkiaterinsu.
Ku sami niwike yuʼiteriwau, waʼwaruʼsa piyapiʼsa ninanuke yaʼwepisu ku pawerearinpuau kanpuasu kehparitawa tuhpinan.
Keteran mamanta kurihki manesu?

Kema Yunkiʼitun sami manaʼpinke: inaʼtun nuwanteresu, inaran maʼsha gustaransu. Kurihki tahparan nahpurini, pawerechitun aʼchinpeike yaʼkunpisu iyaruʼsa inaran paʼaintun pantaʼpi tahshiriamiachin kushatamare. ku kurihki tahparinsu tanareʼna iraterin, waʼwa.
¿Aʼnarahchin kehkaun kusharuʼ?
Ninateke, ira paʼpi ahke kanuhtre.
Kema keparan sami nanpiru werunke, ku ihpura nuya keʼkanaun, piʼiri ihpura nahpunin nitawiriun.
Ku tewarau uʼnanpachina.
Ku ahkete yaniwirainkeun, iya: ku paweretaraiu ihsu semanake, nihpunau nani atariaʼwa paʼan tuhpatui uʼmasarai yunihkaunken.
Wapurusu ahkenanpiarin
Peʼtenan yamura ninanuke.
¿Unpuanta ku winaraunwe shaʼwituatranke yuʼyunen nani kirihka nitu nenterin aʼchin peike? ¿Ku nuya kankantranuwe ina nituhtatun, shiaʼwa?
¿nahpuinahchin niketakasuʼ?
¿Unpu paweretaunta niwiteransu tuma ku maʼsha tehpawataun ihsu semananke, waʼwa? ¿Naʼtanaun naʼkun taweri sanawi?
Ku ahkete paʼteriun nahpuni, kemahsu ku tuhpinan uʼmaʼitun. Kahsu nuwantupirawe taweri ku ahkete paʼterinsu.

¿Paʼitun nimara, iya?-Nuʼten, kuya patuwirawe ihsu ninanuaʼwa. -Sehturuʼku kehparitapu, nipiriunwe aʼnataweri kenantaranke.- Naʼkun yuhse maʼparawiranken, iyahsha, chinkana peiʼ niterankusumare ka paʼpatera ninanuaʼwake.
Nuya kankantupinan inkanaran chinuhteranpihkeran.
Ina atarikayuruʼsa nimara paʼpi paʼtun ninanuke piyapiʼsa yaʼwepisu.
Paʼawai, ku naʼkun taweri yaʼweriunwe. Aʼnawipita
¿Naʼwanan kemahsu tatamahshu irahka chimininsuʼ? Yunkike nani tahshiramiachin kahpa kankanterankeran, ama teʼwakesu, yunkike ina shinpita shaʼwiteke pen yaʼkaria wenserawatun.
Ninanu uʼnankeran pateranpuchinn ihpura kankanteran, nituhteran ihpura piyawi tewewachin nuyahtamasu kemaura.
¿Ninaʼitun wapuru nunshinanke?
Ku kurihki yaʼwetaunpu, ina kahsu naʼkun ayunkirinku.
Ama waʼkikesu tananke, tata. Kasu ku nituwanirawe kawera; weke aʼnaruachin niʼinken winarausu panka kechinken.
Nikatun kemapi ku aʼnaruachin yusparin teniun nanan shaʼwitupisu maʼsha paʼtarisu; tenin ku waʼkiariun maʼsha paʼterinsu nahpuatun ku kahpa yakankanteriun yaʼipi niʼtasui.
¿Nuwanteran kehparichi kemareʼken ninatakamare ihseʼ? mama uʼmawachin iminkeran ahpira niʼpatan ku wai seʼtaun.
¿Paʼanaun arehse?
Ama naʼnekesu, ama manta itekesu iyawarin.

Ninararama ihpera tahshi pen yunsanke, amiaʼwa. ¿Ku naʼwanaunwe kemasu nahtankaru tanan shaʼwinan? Karinta Naʼwanawe. ¿Tewenchin kema nituhtanwe inakeran aʼna taweri mahpintun nihkakamare ahpimashuchin?
¿Paweretaun taʼshira waʼwamahshu sami paʼapatan, maʼpataun tuhpunan nunentun sapumare ninausu waʼwanmare?
Tewenchin wenseran penke pirian uʼnanpachinara, tewenchin kema ninateran aʼnawita ninuwinwen nuya akankantinkesu.
Sehterawe mamanu tananke paʼpachina. ku kahkuterau sehterausu ku interanta shaʼwiterinku unpurusuna uʼmantarin. Peike kehparitatu naʼnerau.
Ina ku kahpa kankanterinwe paʼanterinsumare; nuya nanan nihpirinwe, ku yunkirinwe pawere aʼnarahchin kankikasu inari naʼkun ayunkirin.

Tata ku sami paʼaniunwe ihsu taweri, nahpuatun ku tuma paʼaniunwe ni shapunteranta. Saʼin yunkirin irahka piʼiruʼsa uʼmawi naʼkun peʼpetatuna inaran nuya kankantuatuna. Ihperasu nun tuhpinan uʼmarin nahpuatun ina sehterin.
kema nimara nihkapun kemuinupita

¿ku shaʼwitranwe nunentenaʼpi piyapi kiwipisu wekakaru panka peike shaʼwitakamare unpu nikuidaresu ina shapu akañuterinsu nuhtuaru amiaʼwapita? Kanpua, tatamashuruʼsa, ya nituhtuirayuʼ ma werunuʼsa ainpihtrai inaran ma iʼshata uʼurewa ama kañukamareuʼ iʼwa piʼipuchin.
Yaʼi semanake keterawe kanarausu waʼwaupita, kasu yaʼitaweri yunkirawe waʼwaruʼsa nihpiruwita peike.
Sehteitu ihpera patranke nahpurini, - Kanta inuiʼtu, ihya. - Tahpuna aʼna taweri ku nikenanewau. Nahpuatun Yusparinke ichinke nani taweri weʼnan nunkakamare karuʼku maʼsha akurahsu nuʼpake.
Ina pawerenchin niwintrisu shiʼshimare

Ku kaurahchin ninahtaintuwe shiaʼwanuhsa nihkanku weʼpachina, nihpirinwe ku awantaʼitu maʼsha unpuwinan uʼmawachin tanankeran. Ku nunpisu peike, ku kahsu yunkiʼitu taweri paʼyaninsu. Tahparawe yunkiruʼsa nahpuru yaʼnuipisu iʼshake. Karinsu ninaʼitunke nani iʼwaria, nihpirinwe ku wensatu naʼneitu. Ku kahsu nuwanterawe aʼpayaʼkuanmare ka sehtunu. K uʼmaramau nahpurin, ka kankanewe ku nuya nuya niʼitun.
¿Yaiʼpi paʼanan sami nanpiru ihpura?
Kuʼmantaʼ unpuhtaraʼwe inta ina tahshi aʼpayaninkusu.

Kema nahteranku nahpurini, tahpaʼitun puʼpian shapun paʼankamare, yuʼnanan inaran yamura. ku yaʼiwi tihkiʼitun maʼsha kusirwiterinsu. Inauchin nuya yaʼweitereuʼ, ku kurihki aʼnanchitereu vecinuruʼsa kurihki kahpa nihpachinara.
Ku nanihtauku shapun paʼanausu.
¿Inta yuntunin kepakasu kusharuruʼsa ihsu paʼsarewasumare iʼsha peʼnate parihchi? Samikamayu tahparin nuya kankankeran nunke kuʼwara paʼshatarasu tahshiyachin.
Kemasu nuya paʼitun wapuruke
Ina paʼin mimiriu waʼwashamare
Ku ihpuara irahka ira kenaʼitu.

¿Waʼwasha weʼka ichihtunwe aʼna payahsha panka aʼmisenan pentuntarin kenanin nihpuni? Ina ushahkeran iraterin nunshinankeʼpa, ¿Ku imiranen kechihtunwe? Aʼshimuhtunen, manurin ni yuntunkaimare, yunkike:¿Ku nuyawe waʼwashari puʼpian aʼpaikasu? Aʼna nuya waʼwasha nininsu nuyahshakeran mahshuruʼsa weʼka iterin. ¿Ku nahtanawe unpu weʼerinta tahshi? Inapuchin nuyahsha waʼwaruʼsa suʼsuihtunawe ninanuke.
Ama iʼwatekesu peʼi paʼpatan,tatamahshu. Kahpa nihpatana sehterawe; weke aʼnarachin ama patukusu kaurahchin ihsu iʼshanake
¿Taʼna nihka peʼtenewa ihseke?
Nikahtun sanapi ku kahpakankanterinwe nituhtuwachina iʼsha ku pamatuwachinau; tenin ku peʼpetunu kankiyatararinwe, ku naniteruau yusparin tehshataraʼusu.
Waʼwasha, ¿Maʼpataun tuhpinan pantaʼp ihpera taweri paweretakamare tatanen tanankeran uʼmawachin nuhshare?
Paʼsarau itumare aʼna ninanunen, ku yunkirawe. ¿Niʼnin nihka paʼsaresu nunke ahke aʼna ninanuke?
Nuya nanan mini kanpipirinwe nunturunken, inasu nahpunin kankantahrin; tenin ku naniantawe yunkirausu, nihpunawe naʼkun yunkirinsu inari ku tanawiteriun nuya kankantakasu
¿paʼanchin pantaʼpi itaun mahshu?
¿Yunkiran tenewasu aʼnarumarahchin wenantakasu? Paʼnewa ihshiiparihti wapuruke nihpunawe ku interanta nituhterinwe unpurusuna wenantakasu.

Kepariterewa iʼwawaren sami manewasu nahpuni, ku nanichiteriwau uʼmakasu peiʼpa tahshinanke. Tanankesu tahshiwaʼitun aʼshinpua nzʼkun yunkiʼitun. Nahpuatun ku ahkete waʼkirewau, wiʼnaupita, uʼmantariwa kuʼwaranta tahshiyahtarasuwe, uhshakeran maitehrimaʼawa
Tewenchin yaʼiwi paʼanewa peʼpetun tahshiriamiachin.
Yusparinke uʼnan iteke, sharuʼsa shipiterin niʼtun.
Weʼkama, ¿nani nihka peʼtenewa?
¿Ina mahsu peʼperin yaʼipi peʼpetu?. Iʼi, imirakeran nuyahsha akurin aʼyaitenan inaran waʼwaweʼehta, kahpashin kankantatun paʼsarewasumare.

Ina waʼwasha ku nunkaun nimara kunpañurenen tunpunanke nanpewachin pakakamare. Nihpiriunwe ku ahketeware yunkitakasu ahkekeran, nahpuatun tanan iraruʼsasu ni peshuntupi. Sehtu yaʼkunterinku nani ya tahshiraware, nuya niʼitun ahke niʼterini.Inauwachin paʼnin nahpurini nuya niʼitun.
¿Unpanta ku ahkete naʼneteriun yunkiwachina suʼin chimininsu? Winake, mamapaya, tahpake nuya yunkiransu, tanawiteke pihkeran yaʼipi teʼwateransu.
Mama ama patrakesu. Ku nuwanterawe kawera iminke kehparitaʼwakauhsu; kehpariteke puʼpiamiachin Karuʼku inaran ihpuku.
Ku nihka nituhteraun pakakasu? Yunkirai shaʼwiterateraisu aʼshatuwarin, ku ihpura inasu nituhteriun ahke paʼsarewasu.
¿Wekaun karuʼku?

¿Ku shaʼwitaunku unpanta ku paʼshatararaun? pentuntapun uhshahkeran kara iʼshanaruʼsa, ku ihkaraun iminkeʼpa ihpura. Tanansu ahke ku inake ninarinkeun. Chinihken iratekeʼ, ku mamuwataun ku aʼnarahchin inkanaraun.
Shapun ku paʼanawe paʼanawakare
Yuhse yunkikawe nuyahsha kankantawatu weʼehkamare.

Pantaʼpi paʼanpatan nunshinanke, Kema tahpaʼitun puʼpian kahpa sami nihpachin aʼna taweriruʼsamare. Inuwatan, ku kusharu pawantankeun. Niʼke, waʼwa, iʼshaike ku nanitaweri sami keterinpu, nahpuatun kurihki tahpaʼawa.

Taʼake, kai, iʼwatare. Wankuanake itaunanken kashinuʼsu ku ahkete paʼteriunwe aʼnake paʼanpisu. Ama aʼnarahchin nahtekesu. Kema nituhteran unpu paʼterinsu sahkatunen. Nahtanteke unputa paʼterin nuya paʼankamare. Ama manutunawe.
I waʼwasha kein sharuʼsa ayanakamare
Paʼnanan shapun neʼmehteʼ peʼsakamare

Nimara ina nani nunsha nininke, naʼwanin kain paʼninsu. Nihpiriunwe ku pahkarike naʼneihtunwe ku interanta shaʼwitunawe. Nahpuaware nuniitun aʼnawita sanawirusa ninanukeran. Nahpuinachin naniantaʼawa sehterewasu maʼsha paʼtate, nunkate panayunsake.

Ku nuyahsha kankantau aʼmiawanu ku shaʼwiaunau weʼpachin. Ku kahsu nuya nuya kankantapu ina weʼpachin tahshi tanan irake. Ku winai shaʼwituwachinku, ku nituhtau umpuinta nihsarin. Kahsu ninaʼitu perahterinsu, nihpirinwe ku wenseraʼitu kaurahchin yaʼkuanake. Ku nuwanterau paʼyanaʼkuasu. Ina ku shaʼwitewachinkuuʼ, kahsu ku weʼehpichitu yunkiatu iʼshanaruʼsake wentarahpatun paʼituwachin
¿Wekama iteran piʼpianmare paʼanarinsu?
¿Inawa aʼmihtrai maʼsha keʼkeninsu ahpipira?
Ninateke, aʼnuarachin kansarewa kanuhtuinan.
Chinuhteke, nuya kankantupinan inkanamare.
Ama patekusu paʼanteransuke, miʼseya piʼimini chinihken piʼkatupirinwe; ihpura patuwate ku maʼteranta paʼanariu sami nanpirusu chinarareʼ.

Pama kankiwachinara ku nanitaraunwe peʼikaru, kema yusparinke teʼitun kurihki tahparan irahka niʼtun. Inake pawerechitun niwiteransu kusharumare peimare. Nahpuatun, waʼwa, tahpaʼintun puʼpian. Iʼshasu aʼchinterinpu ku taweri nuyahsha yaʼweriunwe.
¿Yunkianʼtau uʼmantakasu pihta naniwachi ninanuaʼwake? Nahpuhchinachi, kuʼ pamatuachiun. Niʼnaranʼke nahpaware iya. Uʼmantawatu weʼnu uʼantaʼa iya.
kemaran shapun inaran yamura.
yaʼweranke ahke irateranke tumunterin

Paʼpatan iʼsha petehte, ¿Inta paʼaintun sami kehsahwinan? - Weʼitunauwe aʼnawita iyahsharuʼsa. - Ku inawitachahchin niʼitunawe. - Nituhterawe, Iya, nihpiriunwe aʼna taweri uʼmantawe nahpuatun yusparinke ichinke kema nuya piyapi karuʼku ninan niʼtun inaran kemuinuita.
ku inaura weʼniun, Yuhsemare ninaku.
Ama naʼkun ninatekesu, iya, kahtawaku aʼnaruachin iʼkii; ihsu nanpirusami ku wenuka awanteriun, nanitere yuhkasu uskurumare kuʼwaranta tahshiyahtarasu.
Yunkiaʼawa kahtawarinpusu ku teʼwatunawe.

¿Ku nihka paʼpi paʼyananwe nihtutuatan mamawayanen nuyahterinsu? Napurin ina piyapi nuneterinsu werunuʼsake nuyahtanwe aʼnaruachin. ¿Naʼwanan naʼkun kañurahpun? Ka tenawe nahpuran, amiaʼwa. Aʼnaruachin ina wekaunwe kusharu nihkakamare inaran tukinan shaʼwitaunpu nani taʼshi. ¿Tewenchin ninakaunwe ku weʼekaunwe ihpukamare? Nuya nanan nihkaunwe nuyahpiachin kankantariwa yaʼiwinpua kemuisuʼsa. ¿Ku nihka ketaunwe kusharunes paʼyaterinsu?
Ku nahkeranchin chiweantapu tananke, kanuhtupinan ishanake kankimapirawe. ¡ma kahpashin kankantapu ira kenanpatu peinuʼpa uʼmarinsu!
¿Wekama iteran sami nanpiru paʼanarinsu?
¿Ku yuhse yunkikaunwe uʼnanin niʼtun sharuʼsa nitahpakaunwe? ¿Unpuanta teʼwaran sharuʼsa aʼkaunpu nahkaranchi?
ku nunterau interanta ihpura iʼwaria.
Ina ama nanianchisu paweretekamare
Pantaʼpi tahshiyachin kepawachin naʼkun paʼtaun.
Uʼmawatera wankururan, keterawe puʼpiamiachin nuhtawe kusharu nihkamare inaran tahparawe maʼshamare.
¿Teʼwaterin naniantakasu aʼshin? Ama teʼwaksu ami, shaʼwike irahka nanpiransu, nani shaʼwiranke nuya kankanteke.
Ahpi ama kawera patukusu. Tanankeran uʼmawatan ka nuwa kankanterawe, nahpuatun ama waʼkikesu, aʼnarahchin uʼmatun niʼkiku.
Ku kapariwawe sami nanpiru tahshiria.
Ku niwike kechiteriwau atarikayu ku nuwiterewasu, inawasu ku wentaunau, kanpuasu kunpurunta kurihki mahkariwau, waʼwaruʼsa.
Ku kemahsu uʼmaitun ku ninanuke kahpa kashinuʼsa yaʼweriun nahpuni. Kahsu naʼwanau nahpuru taweriruʼsa paʼpi yahshin kushateresu.
ku nahpuinanchi yamura yuʼnawe
¿Ku peʼpeterayu peʼpetun kehken ahpira pira?
Kunimara paʼpin nituhterinwe unpusuna shiʼshi paʼtarinsu.
¿Aʼpamarai nihka taʼna aʼna taweri?
kema nihpun nuhkumarahpun tatamashunen
Uʼnan irahka nanpiransu ayunkipachin, ama niunkurawisu. Pihkike yaʼkuananutake inake nahpuinachin ninaʼa naʼwein teʼwa.
Peʼtenan nuhsha kuʼwaranta paʼanyatarasu.

¿Waʼwashari weʼka ichihtunwe aʼna paʼantenaʼpipaya nunshinanke kenanin nihpuni? Ina sami nanpiru peʼperarin nihpuni, ¿ku nahtaʼintunwe unpuinta nihsaran? Aʼshimuhtun, ni yuntunkaimare manurarin, yunkirin: ¿ku nuyawe Waʼwasha weʼkama tehkasu? Sanapi nunshanenke iʼsha pentuntarin nihpuni, ¿ku ichihtuwe nuya pake? Aʼna nuya waʼwasha inaʼtun weʼka iterin piyapiruʼsa sahkatupihsu ahke ira iʼshake.
Paterinenpuchin ihpura yunkiran tananuʼsa piʼiruʼteri atahshinantuwachina, inairaruʼsa perarinsu nahtanatun nuya kankanteran.
Iya ama ahke pakesu. ku kema ihse nihpatanawe Ku winarawe; aʼnarahchin uʼmake ka winarauhsu kahtapa weʼin.

Ku ira nuwirinsu, ihpera weʼsawisu ku kanʼitunawe inawa ninanuke. Waʼan tenin ku nuya niʼitun iʼwaraya pihpirewa nahpurini, tanansu ku nuya yunkiriunwe nanu paʼpisu. Naʼkun peʼpetrama, ku nanitaumawe iratakaru, tahshitauma nunshinan ahke.
¿ku nihka iʼwara iterankeun paʼsareʼ wapuruke ahke? Yunkirawe shaʼwitereʼ mamanen, nanianterin ihpura ku shaʼwiterinwe.
Ku ina inaura ya winariunwe.
Aʼnanaunkutu imuhtunen tahshiraya ihpura nuwantau.
¿Unpu inkiranta tahshi sehtuwatana? Irahka ayaransu ayake, yunkike nuya taweriruʼsa, winake niyakaparusureʼken.
¿Ku ahpiriachin pakaun? ahketechachin kehparituatan, ku nanitaun iʼshanaruʼsa pentuntamasu uʼnanpachin. Irahsu ahke ku naniteranwe ninakamasu iyawarin. Manuke, shiaʼwa taweri yaʼwerarin.
Muhshake tataparin kañaʼpi
Niyaʼyuranai yaʼweraisu kapini yamura ihpura aʼnanau.
Nuya iʼwateke kemantaʼ, ¿Naniterin nikahtun kemapi ninakasu samikamayu paweretamareʼ aʼna wairuʼ weʼninke, irahka piʼiruʼsapuchin?
¿Naniterin ina nuya kemapi ninakasu pawere aʼma sami keninpaʼ irahka niwike yuʼninpuchin?
NUyahshakeran weʼkama nitawa nani tahshiramiachin, ama ninuʼwiaʼwasuwe
Ku yuʼnau sharuʼsa mamanen kahpa niʼtun
¿Ya weʼnan karuʼku nunshinanke? Tahpuna niʼne nunruʼsa kankiwisu sami aʼnapita kehpisu. Ninateke puʼpiamiachin, nahkeranchin winantaunwe.
Nuyasu kepararin yuʼmenen menta inaran kahpashin kankanterimararin mirkatuke paʼninkeran.
Ku kaura pihpikawe tanan tahshike.
¿unpu tahparamata sami chinpi kepate karasapamare paʼsarewake? Nuyahsha suʼpinpi werunke inaran puʼmupi kepakaimare ahke.
Muhturunta ihpua chinuhtaun wankuiʼ.

Kema yuntunan aʼnaya aʼnaya kurihki nahpurini, yuhki ni taʼwaninpa yaʼwechitekeunwe pantaʼpi paʼankamare, kihsha, inaran yamura. Ama nahtekeru iʼkerahchin. Sami manaʼpi nuya yunkirin tahshiramare, ku ihperahchiunwe inauchin yunkirin. Ina itaunken tatamashunen.
Ku kurihki yaʼwechatarinkui, ku paweretaraiu pahkaturumare; pantaʼpi paʼanpatui kemaruʼku uʼmarawe.
Ni ayakawe nimara maʼsha kehken peʼpewatu.

Taʼake, mama ninasarinpu. Wankuanake yaʼwerin piyapi ku naʼkun maʼsha ya mahpi, ama aʼnarahchin nuwantekesu. Yunkike unputa paʼterin kiʼsha shahkamare. Inara shaʼwike unputa paʼterin inaran ninateke. Nuya nuwantuachinen, nahpuruware paʼanke, ¿Nahtan?
Kai ama naniantukusu. Ninanuke kankirawatan, ka nuwa kankanterawe; weke yaʼnupiaʼa ku nuwankerawe, ahke pakakasu.
Ama naʼnekesu, mama, ihpura piʼpian paʼanteraimare; iʼsha nanitaweria keterinpu, nihpunawe ku tanawinterinpu tuhpinamiachin maʼsha yuhkakasu.
Inaʼtun nuntrauwe, aʼnaruachin paʼankamare.
¿Unpanta ku kahpa kankanterinwe tatamahshunu? Manurawatu nahtapirau nihpunau ku ina aʼpanirinku, iʼsha parihchira nutehtarin nahpurawatun naʼkun sehtarin.
Ama naʼnekesu kemunpinparimareʼ.
Kaura uʼmaitu nimara, paʼpi kanuhtupinan

¿Karuʼku ninataunwe kai ninakamare, waʼwa? Ina wekaunwe waʼwini kanpuasu nuya kankatariwa. ¿Kunihka naʼwananwe peʼnate iʼsha paʼpachina? Aʼnaruachin kenanarewa ira imin paʼsahpachin. Ka tenawe winakaun ihpuwatan. ¿Tewechin kusharunen paʼyaterinsu nihkaunwe ninakamare? Nuya taweri nihkaunwe kemuiruʼsanimare, kemasu nihpiriunwe yunkianpun nuyahsha.
Unanke ku interanta niʼkipachiun, ama sehtekesu. weke iminuke maʼninteranta niaʼa kahtuenpu.
Inahsu ku yusparin teniun nanan shaʼwitupirinau senatapisu, nunpiahpi tehkatun; ku saʼini nanteriun ku kahpakanteriun niʼtun.
Sami nimara paʼterin naʼkun mirkatuke tahshiriaware.
Nikahtun ku paʼankaunwe teniunwe.
Yunkimaranken irahka uʼnanpachinara yaʼnuiruwa.
Kahtawarainke peʼtenan.
Ku sehchitun, shapun kenanan nahpuni iarahkauchin ku ahkete paʼterisu. Yunkirawe nuhtuwaru maʼsharuʼsa kemawatana peʼpetun kiyamareʼ
Weʼkama ahpi. Umpuwachina kemanta yunkiran kehparitamareʼkemaurachin uʼnanarinke, iʼshana pamatuwachina ku waʼwarusa tanankeran uʼmapiwe
Ku nanihtaunku yamuramareʼ.

Ina Waʼwasha aʼchinaʼpi kenanin irake, ¿ku Weʼkama ichitun? Ina Aʼshin muhtun, manurarin shaʼwikamare ninanuawake, Yunkirin: ¿ina waʼwasha ku nuyau niʼitun nahtanin nahpurin unpuinta nihsarin? Ina sanapi irahtapachin nunshinan irahke, ¿ku kaʼtaintun ni aʼnarutranta? Aʼna waʼwasha yunkinaʼpi weʼkama teʼitun inaʼtun. ¿ku nituhchitu aʼnaruahchin nuya piyapi nihkakasu aʼnawita nahkupisu?
Maniatun, paʼawa iʼsha akutaʼawa kuʼwana piʼi pihpirarin.
ku naniriun yuhkamare, weke maniatun

Nuyahsha nunchitun waʼwasha aʼna tanankamai niʼnin uʼmarahrin tanankeran? Ina kemapi manurarin iʼsha pentuntamare, ¿ku nuwanchitu nuya pakakamare? Waʼan ninanuaʼwakeran aʼnuarachin irachitun inaran ni nahtaʼintun: ¿Ku nimara nuyahsha niʼitun waʼwahsha iʼwata tenin nahpurin? ¿Ku nuwanchitu tanankamai chinuhtakasu panka irake? Aʼna nuya waʼwasha nani taweri nuyahpiachin nunin winaunpuchin uʼmararinsu kanuhtereʼna.
Ama manukesu, iya, ihsu sami ku nanpiru, ku nuwanterau piyawpiʼsa tehkakaisu nahpunin paʼantarewa ninanunenpua.
Peʼperan kehken tanpanante, sanapi.

Napuwi ina sehteru yaʼkunterin iyashanen yunkiwachina iʼke ahku paʼninsu. Ku sehtu tahpaitun ahkete kankanenke. Nuya niʼitun saʼantakaru winantaʼitun waʼwarusawitare. Nahpuatun, naʼwaninsu puʼpian puʼpian ku ahkete ikechitun.
Kuʼmantaʼ unpuhtaraʼwe tewaʼnewe taʼshinanke.
Pantaʼpinu aʼnanpaten, inaran kurihki yaʼwetaunken paʼanpatan.
Kepawatera paʼteresu wankuanawe, puʼpian ninausu waʼwaupita keterawe inaran suʼyawe nuyamiachin keterawe.

ku kahsu nuwanchihtu ahpiaʼwanu pakakasu ku nuntankurawe, waʼwa. kasu ku tahpaitu nuya yunkiruʼsa nuʼwiterenan paʼpachin. ku niʼnawe nahpurini winarinsu ku paʼshahtasu, ku kasu nuya kankanchitu. kari ninaitu yaʼi taweri iminke, nihpiriunwe ku kushatuinan kehparichitu. ku kasu nuwanterawe ayakasu tananke. ku ina uʼmawachinwe, kasu ku chinuhchitu yunkiatu iratarinke.
Maniatun, mahke pantaʼpi. Paʼanpatan wankuanake, kemasu nunteran piyaʼwisa inaran shaʼwiran unputa paʼterin. Ama puʼpian aʼpatekesu teʼwarapatan. Piyapiʼsa
Uʼnan ihpura irahka unpuransu a ayunkirin, yunkiran ihpura peinenke aʼpetatun akahpakankankasu iʼwaria.
Kema paʼanan sami nanpiru nani semanake, ku nihpunau nituhterau paʼanterinensu pawererinen kema nahtanteransuchahchin.

¿ku nihka muhsharewau niyuntupiʼpa panka peike aʼnapita aʼachinkamare unpu tahparesu kusharuruʼsa ama kankain ikihtamareu? Kanpuasu paterewa nuhsha piʼike nahpuatun naʼkun kañupi, nahpuatun tenai naʼta nahpunin ninewa nahpuru.

Maniatun, paʼawa wankuanake ahpira. Pantaʼpi paʼanpatan, nahtanteke unputa paʼterin. Ama nikanatekesu tuhpinan, kemasu naʼkun sahkateran iminke. Niʼke aʼnawita nahtantui kurihki inauchin maʼpatuwi. Inauchin ama nunpinchinkesu, Iyamasu.

Ina ku keniun kashinunʼsa waʼwinpita ninahtapirinawe, pantaʼpi kuwai paʼanewe. Sanapi nanun yunkirin irahkasu ku maʼshateranta kashin pawaniunwe uʼmawatera. Ina piʼiruʼsa nuyasha yaʼwerusu kuwai uʼmariunwe, ninanuʼsu ku irahkauchin.
Paʼsamaranke iʼke inawitaranken
¿Unputa paweretaun werunuʼsame nimiriunu, puʼpian paweretaun iʼwara nani nunesu iʼsha yunsainke?
Shaʼwimarewa iratarewasu waʼkiariwa inaran ahkerarewa. ¿Nahtanan shaʼwirewa waʼkirarewasu naʼkun taweriruʼsa wapuruke?
¿Maʼta ketaunenpua nihka ninanuke?
Kaʼtawarewa nihka paʼanakamare pantaʼpi.
Aʼnatauri naniantaun panka sehteransu
Tahshiraya ku ihseke nihkaunwe. Inauchin yaʼnurin, ka iyahsa. Ihpurawaten patarankenwai, ninuwe ikihtuirawe.- ka aʼnatauweri kenantaʼihtenken paʼanase ihme iʼsha yunsanke.
Ku yamura niwike kepariwau ku nuwantuataun, ku ihpura paweretaraiu, nihpunau nimiriu kechinken waʼwan kañurinmareʼ.
Ama naʼnekesu paʼyankesu uʼnanapachin. Suʼketeke waʼwanpita inaran ayaateke, sehtusu iʼshari ahke kepararin.
Chinihken uʼnanpachin, ama teʼwakesu. Yunkike aʼshiparin winakaun piʼpian, tananke irahka winarepuchin.
shatrewasu ku naniariun yaʼiwimare
¿kehkaun maʼshateranta mamanumareʼ?
¿Paʼsaraun chihtun yaʼ ipi ya paʼpatana?- Kemaura nimara, iyahsa, kema iyanupuhchi ninan niʼtun.- Sehtu mentahchitunku, nihpiriunta nuya kanka. Yusparinke ichitun
Nani wiriake keparan kashinuʼsa mirkatuke, ku ihpura interanta paʼanaun nahkeranchachin ichiayantaun peike.
¿Ku kmasu niʼnanwe aʼshatunen chinihkin kemawi wairinsu? Yusparinke tehke ihsu nananmare, amiaʼwa, nanianteke teʼwaransu ihsu taweriruʼsa.
sehterin iʼsha aʼnaitanken inaran naʼwanin nunpiru piyawininpita

Kema tahparan kurihkinen nunpuchin nahpurini, ku unpurunta maʼsha pawantankeunwe. Yamura pawerechitun, shapunta inaran tahpaintun kañumare. Karin nuya nunchinken, waʼwa: Sami manaʼpi nuya weʼerin iʼsha paʼmaiwachinara.
Ku uʼmakau ku shapun paʼanpatu, wiʼnau.
¿Tuhpinan maʼpataun yuʼnanan ihpera paweretakamare kahtu samirare uʼmawachin iʼshantekeran iʼwaraya?
¿Nuya niʼitun niwike nahtanakasu arina niyaʼyuranesukapini, ayunkirawate inahsu paweterinsu sami naʼkun manin pihkeran?

¿Ku kiyasu muhshaterayu aʼnawita ni aʼchinkamare aʼnawita anutupi yuʼname ikihtatuna tehkei iʼsha uʼupiran? Kiya, mahshunkui, nuwantuirayu iʼsha inpihtakaru, nahpuanau ku interanta shaʼwiterinkuyu unpu uʼukaru nuyahsha.
¿Unputa manan kurihki pantaʼpi paʼananke?

Maniatun nahtanteke. Paʼpatama wankuanake paʼanakamare, kampita yunkirama unputa paʼterin kahtu yaʼpima irahka. Inauchin ku interanta puʼpian aʼpataunawe inapihkeran ni awauna. Paʼanapi kemapi ku naʼkun maniuwe, kema ninateke nuyahsha. Nuya paʼanke ama manukesu kurihki ku naʼkun kanawatun.
¿A inpite iʼsha ama kañukamareu?

Kema waʼwinshinkeraware tahpawatan kurihki nahpurini, paʼaintun aʼyaiteresu sami mahkakamare. Ina kurihkiriʼken pawerehchitun shapun mamanenmare. Karin achinchinken, yaʼwereʼsu ninanuke ku nuwantiuʼ tuhpinan yaʼwekaru.
¿Nunentu sanapi ninin wiʼsha ketarin ninunentamare?
Kema pihpiran tahshiramiachin nantiwireʼ, nihpirinwe ku nituhterawe unputa paʼterin atarikayuruʼsa nanihtaun nihka yaʼipi piyapiʼsa paʼanakamare.
Paʼsarewa ku uʼnanpanchuin.
Nuya peʼtenan samipihshate.
¿Unpuanta taʼteran naputuantranke ihsu piʼihke sharuʼsa nihtaunwe? ¿Ku Yuhse yunkikaunwe ku wai tana naʼwerareuw, waʼwa.?
¿Ku ahkete nuwanteriun niwike yuʼnana yukakasu, irahka mahshuruʼsa nipisupuchin, paweretapi tahshiachin sami mahpike?
Ku niwike keparaiwe ku shaʼwitainkenau, ahpi ku nunpintarankeun, ninararai senatu pawerekaʼinmare.
¿Paʼantaunkutu yamura ninanuke?
¿Naʼnantaun nahkeranchin? Mamapayanen weʼkaun aʼnaruahchin inake shaʼwinan shaʼwitaunke nuyahpiachin. Nuyahsha kankantaun inareʼken.
Nuya kakanteke, tahshira piʼi pihpikaunwe.

Waʼwasha kenanin ahpin nunshinankeran uʼmararinsu, ¿ku nuyahshakeran weʼka ichihtunwe? Aʼshimuhtunen, manurarin sahkatamare, nahtanin¿Ku nuyawe ina kemuinmare nahtantakahsu? Ina ahpi pantaʼpi kepararin nihpuni, ¿Ku puʼpianteranta kahtawaituwe? Aʼna nuya waʼwasha weʼka tenin irake. ¿Ku weʼkama ichihtunwe nuyahsha nanankeran iraparihchin naʼwerarin nihpuni?
Ka nihpiriunwe maʼsha niketrai kairuʼku, kari keʼsha ketrauwe inahsu ketrinku pantanʼpi; nahpuatun kuʼsharu ku peike pawaniun.
Ihpuku, ihsu uʼnan a sehterinku.

Aʼna wiʼnapi paʼpachina ahke aʼchin peike, aʼnawita sehtupi inamare. Ku ina naʼkun yunkikasu nihpiriunwe, ina uʼmawachin nisha nisha nituhtun aʼchinkasumare. Nimara nuya niʼitun kaʼtanasukamare iʼsha yunsanke. Nahpuatun ni patakaru nuya niʼitun waʼiwimare.
¿Unpanta pʼpihshamare paʼanan, tata?
Ama teʼwateksu wira ihpura tahshi. kehparike waʼwan pirian inaran tewasaran niʼpatan paʼpi weʼemiaterinsu.
Iʼwata ahpi. Naniteran kema ihsu penenpuchin nituhteke yuniraushu uʼnan anutuwachina iminke ka ninuwinewe inaurahchin kehpariterin
Kepaʼawa sami imuyamare tahshira.

Wiʼnapi ku paʼaniunwe nahsha yuʼnanan kumuiruʼsa ku paʼaniunwe sami naʼkun niʼtun. Aʼshin napurin irahkasu iʼsha keterinpua naʼkun nahpuatun inapita ku tana nahtanpiu. Ihperasu ku inauchinwai, nahpuatun ina sanapi naʼwanin irahka waʼwepisu.
Ina paʼain aʼnarachin sharuʼsa
Ama naniantekesu ina nuwantrinkesu.
¿Ku nihka shaʼwiterankeun paʼsaresu? Ku ihpura kahpayachatasun pihpire, wapurusu ku interanta ninarinwe tahshiyachin.
Chinuhtauntu ira ahke nihpachin.

Waʼan teni ku intranta paʼitun ku shaʼwikunawe, ku nun yaʼweriun iyaruʼsa ku nanitaunawe kakankaru aʼna Yunsaʼpa. ku nuyawantuachinawe, ku nanichitrawe pentunkaru ihpera. Paʼa ninataʼawa, manuwiramawe con ihkantamawe ninanu ku uʼnayantasu.
sehterau suʼsurausuʼninanuʼawa yunkiatu
Weʼkama, iyaruʼsa; nanan nuyahtaʼwa aʼrahchin, pei anuyakankantawa.
Yunkiaʼawa nuyahpiachin nuya imiraterinsu.

Nimara Tahshiraya paʼsaran ahke iʼsha peʼnahte maitupinan, iyara. Paʼpatuhsu tahshirayamiachin. Sehteʼihtuwe ku kankiranwe paʼanteraweʼpa niʼtun. Karinta yusparin itaranke ihsu piʼihke weʼnan paʼanpu kahken Samira.
Ku aʼnaruachin kuhtaru mentahtuatewau, ku puʼmukariwau putike, kanpuasu ku inkantariwau maʼsharuʼsa peʼtenakasu kuʼwaranta kamutechin nihshatarasu.

¿Ku nihka wiʼsharewauʼ waʼinpua nunewasu niyuntunuwake panka peike ni aʼchintakamare unpu ninunenkamare ama iru mahkakamareuʼuʼnanpachina? Kiyahsu nuwanterai nunentenaʼpi piyapi aʼchinchinkui unpureta waʼwasha sapuwachina ku chini yaʼwetuachinawe.

Kemapi Ku pantaʼpi peʼperiunwe nunkeware Ku interante paʼaniunwe niʼtun. Saʼin yunkirin irahka piʼiruʼsasu yaʼiwi kemuiruʼsa nuya paʼanpi Ku kusaru pawanpiriunwe. Ina taweriruʼsa Kahpawai, napurin sehtatun.
¿Ninaterai yaʼiwinkui nani iʼwaraya?
Ama sehtekesu, tatamahshu, ku interanta paʼantuanchinpu ihpura; tahshiria uʼmantaʼwa nunshinanke, yuʼa sami uskurumare inaran arehsemare.

Ku nihka yunkiranwe mahshuruʼsa wensaʼsu tene sami paʼanpate kurihki tahpaʼa, ihsu piʼihke nakun paterin yamuraʼ paʼane. ¿Kuʼ nihka tenewe ama tihkiaʼaru aʼna taweriran kurihke, kemuinenpu kurihke aʼma pawantakasuʼmarewe iʼsha winkintuachin?
Nuntaranke aʼshatu. Umpuwachina kema nituhteran ka yunihsarawe piʼpian penenpuchin uʼnanawachina yunkirawe taweriruʼsa kemuinuita yamuraisu

Ku chinuhtuateu, ku nun kanʼitun aʼnateran yunsanke ku piʼi paʼmahtasu. Waʼan tenin ku interanta naʼkun peʼpetaun, naʼkun peʼpetuatama ku ahpira kanʼitumawe. Manuku, iyaruʼsa, ku ihpera taweri nichiwatamawe waʼiwima ku interanta kankaun aʼna ninanuke.

Ku nihka yunkiranwe, aʼyanan paʼtaripuchin, tene paʼa tahpaʼa puʼpianteranta uʼna taweriruʼsa? Naʼkun sami mane, nihpirinwe aʼnaruahchin tihkirewa. Nahpuatun tenewa ama aʼnuarahchin tihkiawaru sahkairan iʼsha keterinpu.

¿Ninakaunwe uʼna karuʼku, amiaʼwa? Tehkei nani paʼmarin sharuʼsa yamuruwi. ¿Ku nuya kankantaunwe iʼsha mentaiwachin nanitarewa peʼyantakaru nahkerachin? Mahshuruʼsa tehpi aʼnuaraʼchin uʼnankaunwe chinihken. ¿Ku nihka naʼwanaunwe irininsu isha paʼpachina? Karin kepaʼinke nihkamare unpu nanperinsu. Nuya nanan nihkaunwe yaʼi ninanumare chinuhtu unkai. ¿Tewenchin kema niiraran paʼyantun uʼnan wiʼshiwachin Puwipiteke?

Iyaruʼsa ¿Ku nihka tenewau paʼankasu sami inaran tahpakasu kurihki nunennuʼsamare inaran yamura paʼantakasumare? Naʼkun yunkirewa ku uʼnaniwen niʼtun. ¿Ku nihka inuachin yunkirewawe yaʼpira ni nitawatewa kemaichachin?
Inauwachin tahshiria nimara pahkaritapun
Kiyasu ihpura shaʼwiterai waʼan paʼsaraisu aʼna parihchi. ¿Naniantumarewa shaʼwitakasu kuʼwaranta wapuruke nanpeyahtarasu?
karin nuyahsha nuntaranke aʼshatu. Umpuwachina kema, kahpuchin,ku nuyahsha kankanterrawe uʼnan kankiwachina peiʼ tanawanterin kahpa interanta nihpachina tawinanke
Ama pakesu kanuhtuatan.
Kaʼtanke kemupiwain, ama naʼnekesu.
Nuyasu amin peʼperarin nihsha nihsha kashinuʼsa inaran paʼanin mirkatuke.
Weʼkama ahpi. kema nimara nituhtumaranke, uʼnan patuwachinkura kaurahchin, ihseke nihsapatana piʼpiamiachin nuyahsha kakanterinku ihsu tawerike
Ama karuʼku tatekesu, Yuʼyu. Nani tashiriamiachin ka nuya kankanterawe; nuntuku ama patekesu yuhsemare.
Sanapisu ku yusparin teniun waʼwin nuya nihsarinsumare ku nuya nahtaniun niʼtun; ku kahpa yakankanteriun ku niʼpachiun nunentu peikeran uʼmarawachin.
¿paʼantaunku shapun nahtanaensu?
Ku teʼwarawe iʼsha irinpachin.
¿Maʼta unpurinta iin naʼwanpachina? pake iminkeʼpa, nuya kankantatun sahkateke, sharuʼsa shaʼninsu nihkatun nuya kankanteke.
Chinuhtaun kuʼwaranta inkanyantarasu nunshinanpa.
Paʼpi ikirutupinan inkanaran, piʼpian chimnuhteke.
Mahkinanpi ihpura naʼkun aʼpatakasu ahke mirkatuke.
Nahpumara kahken nun aʼnain nihpai, nihpunawe shipin nihsarin.
Uʼnansu ku nuya kankanteresu keniun.
Ku ahkete nuʼwichiʼitun ku yaʼipi naʼkun paʼterinwe nahpuni. Kahsu naʼwanau
Aʼnanauku waʼnaweʼehtanen, yunkirau nihpunau nuwantamaraen ihpura.
pihkeke ninuwinen kunai niʼpatan kuhsinapeike
yaʼpira yunirin nuwiterinsuʼ,nahpanawe ku nuwiterinwe taʼterantapi
¿Kunihka keparinkeun wapuru nunshinanpawareu?
¿Ku nuya kankantraunwe kemasu nunentenaʼpi napurin mamapaya sanurarin niʼtun? Yuhse maʼparawike, Waʼwa, aʼpuke wai ihsu taweriruʼsa sehteransu.
¿Paweretaun wenu tuhpinan pihta maʼpateransu, u sahkataun iminke ama ina kemawi miwikamareu?
¿Yaʼipi piʼpiamare paʼanan, tatamahshu?

Ku meʼtanaun uʼnanpachina, yunkiran piyawiʼsa chiminpisu, inake yunkiran tewepisu, ama ahkete sehtamarewe
Ina ku kahpa kankanteriun shaʼwituwachinara, uʼnan ku nahpunin imin akuriun; naʼkun yunkirahrin ku shaaruʼsa niʼniun niʼtun.
Kemaura nihpatan uʼnapachin nanteshinante irintaunwe, ama teʼwakesu. Yuhse nunteke kemuinenmare nahpuwatan sehtu naʼwetaunken iʼshauchin.

¿Unpuanta naʼneran, iyaraʼwa? Tahshira nimara pakawe iʼkeʼpa kemareʼken tahpuna peʼire unar. Nuya kankantanwe, niʼkena, ama naʼnekesu wai.
